source.doc_type: Reviewed condensed consolidated and separate interim financial statements 2Q2026 (Thai)

notes: Quarterly (6 months to 30 June 2026 = year to date). Scanned; read locally, pages located by their headings (file page numbers). Reviewed, not audited (Deloitte). Thousand Baht. The SCI (three months p.6, six months p.8) has consolidated and separate columns; the separate columns are used (owner decision); it prints the tax expense positive (turned negative). Note 20.1, six months (columns GMM 6.1 / PAA 6.2 / VFA 6.3 / total): revenue p.65, expenses p.66 printed positive (turned negative). CSM roll-forward = GMM (p.25, closing p.26) + VFA (p.40), CSM columns, ณ วันที่ 30 มิถุนายน 2569; new business = GMM p.28 + VFA p.42 totals. Each summed item records the GMM page. Future-service change = change in estimates + experience adjustment. VFA accretion is nil. RA release uses 20.1 (141,703). Other expense = other finance costs + other operating expenses. The three-month profit or loss is the separate SCI for the three months to 30 June 2569 (p.6).
